name: Hypogeal
source:
Trees are motionless here. Not because there is no wind, but because they aren't real. Naturally, you're curious when someone shows you a wooden board for an ancient game. It's incredibly popular right now. Perhaps that's why you can't stop playing it.

[From [url=https://whilegameisfalse.itch.io/hypogeal]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这里的树木一动不动。不是因为没有风，而是因为它们不是真实的。当有人向你展示用于古代游戏的木板时，你自然会感到好奇。它现在非常受欢迎。也许这就是为什么你无法停止玩它的原因。

[来自[url=https://whilegameisfalse.itch.io/hypogeal]Itch.io[/url]]
